entries.zh: 平民；庶民；普通百姓（与贵族、官绅相对）
entries.en: commoner; plebeian; person of the common people

entries.zh: 平常人；凡俗之辈；寻常无身份者
entries.en: ordinary person; common sort; unremarkable fellow

entries.zh: 匹夫；平民男子（含轻贱意味）
entries.en: common man; ordinary fellow (often pejorative)

entries.zh: 平庸之辈；寻常无奇者
entries.en: mediocre sort; ordinary person; run-of-the-mill

entries.zh: 中等之人；寻常人（原稿“中缘人”非习见成词，义据四栏推得）
entries.en: person of middling or common sort; ordinary person
entries.notes: 漢字「中緣人」非習見詞，R 欄空，義僅據 L=plebeyo 與 M 末字「lang（人）」推得。

entries.zh: 中品；中等品第（指身份平常之人）
entries.en: middle grade; of middling rank or status

entries.zh: 刁滑；刁钻好讼（指狡诈健讼之人）
entries.en: tricky; crafty; given to sharp practice in litigation
entries.notes: 原稿「Pleytita」与漢字「刁」并观，当为 pleitista（好讼之徒）之音写，非 pleita（草辫）之义。

entries.zh: 口齿尖利；利口善辩（贬义，指好争讼者）
entries.en: sharp-tongued; glib; argumentative
entries.notes: M「chiuy lay」即「口利」，与上行「刁」同为 pleitista 一系之注。

entries.zh: 诉讼；告状；提起诉讼
entries.en: lawsuit; to sue; to bring an action

entries.zh: 讼事；争讼；诉讼与诉求（demanda）
entries.en: litigation; legal suit; claim or complaint (demanda)

entries.zh: 呈状；书面诉状；递状起诉
entries.en: written petition or plaint; lawsuit in writing; to file written pleadings
entries.notes: H「呈」为呈递之状，M「sia. cô.」当读「寫告」（写状上告），二者互证书面兴讼之义。

entries.zh: 诬告；捏词兴讼
entries.en: false accusation; trumped-up suit; to slander

entries.zh: 诬告（捏造罪名控告他人）
entries.en: false accusation; malicious prosecution

entries.zh: 官司；涉官府的讼事（与 L 栏“伪讼”义不尽合）
entries.en: lawsuit; official case (H 官事; the sense 'false' is not carried by the Chinese)
entries.notes: 漢字「官事」只指涉官讼事，不含「伪」义，与 L 栏 pleito falso 略有出入。

entries.zh: 讦告；揭人阴私而兴讼（原稿附长句训释，后半字迹难辨）
entries.en: to accuse and expose someone by suit; to inform against
entries.notes: M 前二音「quier cô」即「訐告」，与 H 合；其后长句（tui chu tang chin, yô sio tôa）污损，未能尽释。

entries.zh: 打官司；进行诉讼
entries.en: to litigate; to go to law; to be at law

entries.zh: 互相告状；彼此兴讼
entries.en: to sue one another; mutual accusation

entries.zh: 讦告；揭发控告
entries.en: to accuse; to inform against; to prefer a charge

entries.zh: 与对方当事人对质；当面对簿
entries.en: to confront the opposing party; face-to-face confrontation in court
entries.notes: 「對主」（tui chu）按诉讼语境解作对质，亦可能泛指对事主/主人，今取对质义。

entries.zh: 动手；着手（就兴讼、交锋而言）
entries.en: to take action; to set to; to come to grips
entries.notes: 「動手」本义为动手、着手，置于 pleitear 条下当指动讼、交锋，义界较宽。
